title: add RAG templates, agent/tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR adds a set of reproducible RAG templates, agent/tool-calling quickstarts, and accompanying docs site updates. Motivation: make it faster for engineers to onboard RAG and agent patterns using Redwood's API and SDKs, and provide vetted examples for common tool-calling workflows (search + browser + code-exec). Changes are scoped to example projects, docs pages, and a small SDK helper in the redwood-examples and redwood-docs repos. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG template project (redwood-examples/rag-template) - [x] Add agent tool-calling sample (redwood-examples/agent-tool-calling) - [x] Add Python and TS examples for quickstarts - [x] Docs site pages and navigation entries - [x] E2E smoke tests for examples in CI - [x] Minimal SDK helper to simplify tool invocation (non-breaking) High level: - new quickstarts under redwood-quickstarts/ and redwood-examples/ showing a baseline RAG pipeline with chunking, embeddings, and a small retrieval index based on sqlite; includes a documented eval prompt set and sample dataset. - agent/tool-calling example demonstrates safe function signatures, structured output parsing, and a small local tool registry that uses Redwood's function-calling semantics. - docs site updates add a "RAG & Agents" section with three walkthroughs, architecture diagrams, and copy for common gotchas (cache sizing, prompt templates, hallucination mitigation). - CI: added smoke test job `examples-smoke` that runs the Python quickstart in a lightweight container using mocked credentials and a local sqlite corpus. Implementation notes: - Examples are intentionally small but opinionated; they include a `config.yaml` for batching / cache settings used in the walkthroughs. - The SDK helper is opt-in and lives under redwood-sdk-python/examples/helpers/rag_agent.py; it's flagged in the docs and tests to avoid any implicit behavior changes in the public SDK. - No runtime changes to core `redwood` serving code; only examples and docs except for a tiny helper import in the Python examples repo. Related: Linear: ENG-3421 (RAG quickstarts), DOCS-128 (docs nav for agents).
